content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IRCTC Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IRCTC recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the IRCTC Qualified CA/CMA posts is scheduled for 28th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Qualified CA/CMA post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Qualified CA/CMA position in the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this IRCTC recruitment?
faq.answer: To be eligible for this recruitment, candidates must possess a Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Qualified CA/CMA posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for these positions is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Qualified CA/CMA position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Qualified CA/CMA role will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 70,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this IRCTC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates for this IRCTC recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IRCTC Qualified CA/CMA recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview, followed by Document Verification, and finally, the announcement of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, etc.), and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Secunderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 500003. The exact address will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job opportunity with the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC).
